Name: Happy Clint
Author: RabidSamus
Description:
This mod rewrites Clint's usual day-to-day dialogue to make him less depressed and happy with his job. It also rewrites some event dialogue to make him more confident and willing to change and better himself further.

[u]Currently included in the mod:[/u]
- Normal dialogue (1.5 compatible)
- Festival dialogue
- Clint's 3-heart-event
- Clint's 6-heart-event
- Emily's 8-heart-event

If you have feedback or wishes, feel free to comment or send a message!

[u]Changelog[/u]
1.1.1 - Fixed a typo and added Clint's happy portraits to certain 1.5 dialogue. Also minor .json file fixes. :)
1.1.2 - Added/changed some festival dialogue
1.2.0 - Added a line for the Night Market
